intro.h2: Remodeling for the projects other contractors pass on
paragraphs: DMP Remodels does kitchen and bath remodeling in Batavia, IL, and it does not stop there. One client says he has thrown "various, random projects" at the team, and every one came back done quickly and better than he expected.

Darren runs the work and stays easy to reach. When one family had water damage and was living in a hotel, his team got the repairs done in a short time so they could go home. It was their second time hiring DMP, and most of our reviews come from people like that: clients who call back for the next job.

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Full kitchen updates, from cabinets and countertops to backsplash and flooring. The open kitchen in our photos shows the look: white cabinets, a center island, recessed lighting and wood-look floors running into the dining area. Kitchen remodels are one of the topics reviewers mention most.

image.alt: Remodeled white kitchen with center island, stainless refrigerator and wood-look floor opening to a dining table

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Bathrooms where the small choices match. On a recent vanity, the brown veining in the top ties into matching veining in the backsplash, so the whole room feels planned rather than pieced together. Bathroom remodels are tied with kitchens as the most mentioned job in our reviews.

items.name: Custom carpentry and woodwork
items.blurb: DMP started with custom woodworking and carpentry, and it shows in the trim work. Think shiplap fireplace walls with a rustic wood mantel, wainscoting, accent walls and stair details built on site to fit the room instead of ordered off a shelf.

image.alt: White shiplap fireplace wall with rustic wood mantel and black brackets beside navy painted walls

items.name: Walls, drywall and repairs
items.blurb: Old houses hide surprises. On one job we pulled off wood paneling and found a time capsule of drywall disasters underneath, so we skim coated the walls smooth before the new trim went up. We also handle repairs after water damage.

image.alt: Staircase with wood treads, black iron balusters and a black geometric trim accent wall

items.name: Doors and smaller projects
items.blurb: Front door installation is a regular request, and reviewers say the new doors turned out perfectly. If you have a list of odd jobs around the house, send it over. One client says you can have literally anything done in your home.

items.title: Clients come back
items.text: Several reviewers are repeat customers. One family hired us a second time after water damage, and another client keeps sending us one project after another.

items.title: Work gets done fast
items.text: Timely completion is a review topic on our Google profile. When a family was living in a hotel during repairs, finishing in a short time mattered, and we did.

items.title: You deal with Darren
items.text: Reviewers name Darren directly and describe him as very nice and pleasant to work with. You talk to the person running the job, not a call center.

items.title: Every review is five stars
items.text: DMP Remodels holds a 5.0 rating across 16 Google reviews, covering kitchen remodels, bathroom remodels, front doors and repair work.

about.text: DMP Remodels grew out of custom woodworking and carpentry, and today it takes on full home and business remodeling around Batavia and Naperville. Darren leads the team. Clients describe him as reliable, easy to work with and quick to get things done. Owner replies to reviews are personal, like the note thanking a homeowner for letting the team help bring the old charm back into his house. That is the approach on every job: treat the house with care, fix what is hiding behind the walls, and finish the details so the space feels intentional.

process.h2: How a project with us works

steps.title: Call or email
steps.text: Reach Darren at (708) 415-1719 or DMPRemodels@gmail.com, Monday to Friday between 10 AM and 6 PM, and tell us what you have in mind.

steps.title: Look at the space
steps.text: We walk through the room with you, talk through layout and finishes, and point out anything that needs fixing before new work goes in.

steps.title: Plan and price
steps.text: You get a clear scope for the job so you know what is included, what materials are going in and what it will take to finish.

steps.title: Build and fix what we find
steps.text: The team does the work. If old paneling hides damaged drywall, we deal with it properly, like the skim coat on our stairway job.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: We go over the finished space with you together, check the details, and make sure you are happy before we call the job done.

service_area.h2: Kitchen and bath remodeling in Batavia, IL and Naperville
service_area.text: DMP Remodels is based in the Batavia and Naperville area and takes on home and business remodeling projects there. If you are close by and are not sure whether your address is in range, call (708) 415-1719 and ask. The same goes for job size: kitchens, bathrooms, front doors, trim and repair work are all on the list, so describe what you need and we will tell you straight away.

items.q: What kinds of projects do you take on?
items.a: Kitchen and bathroom remodeling, custom cabinets, countertops, backsplash and flooring, plus custom carpentry like fireplace walls and trim. We also install front doors and repair walls after water damage. One client says he has sent us various random projects and every one was finished quickly.

DMP Remodels works in the Batavia and Naperville area of Illinois. Our Instagram lists Batavia and our Facebook page lists Naperville. If you live nearby and want to check whether we can reach you, give us a call at (708) 415-1719.

We are open Monday through Friday from 10 AM to 6 PM and closed on Saturday and Sunday. You can call (708) 415-1719 during those hours or email DMPRemodels@gmail.com any time, including weekends. Replies come during those weekday business hours.

items.q: How do I get a price for my project?
items.a: Call (708) 415-1719 or email DMPRemodels@gmail.com with a short description of the job and a few photos if you have them. We will set up a time to look at the space and then put together a price for the work.

items.q: Can you help after water damage?
items.a: Yes. One of our Google reviews comes from a family who had water damage and was living in a hotel while the work was done. They say Darren got it finished in a short amount of time. It was the second time they had hired us.

final_cta.h2: Have a kitchen, bath or odd job in mind?
final_cta.text: Call Darren and tell us about it. We answer Monday to Friday, 10 AM to 6 PM.
